settings.steamNote: Your Steam account needs at least five euros of purchases; Valve refuses to issue keys otherwise.

settings.googleDescription: Optional. Allows signing in with a Google account that has been linked to an existing login.
settings.googleStep1: Open the Google Cloud Console and create a project if you do not have one.
settings.googleStep2: Under Credentials, create an OAuth client ID of type Web application.
settings.googleStep3: Add the address below as an authorised redirect URI.
settings.googleNote: This address must match exactly, including scheme and path. It can only be changed in the Google Console, not here.
settings.mailDescription: Required for invitations and password resets.
